contract.selective_unregister: Unregister removes only the listener matching both plugin ownership and bound-method identity
contract.bound_method_identity: Bound-method identity is based on instance identity and underlying function identity
contract.listener_preservation: Removing one bound-method listener preserves other listeners registered for the same event
contract.delivery_isolation: After selective unregister only remaining listeners receive the event
contract.permission_enforcement: Register and unregister operations require the plugin events permission
contract.registry_stability: Selective unregister leaves the remaining listener registry intact
